name: Kettlebell Windmill
description: A windmill performed with a kettlebell overhead, identical in pattern to the dumbbell version but using the kettlebell's unique center of gravity that demands greater shoulder stability. The offset weight of the kettlebell adds rotational challenge to the overhead arm.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Kettlebell Windmill in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Kettlebell Windmill.
steps: Step 1: Clean and press kettlebell overhead in one hand, feet wide.
Step 2: Turn lower foot 45 degrees outward. Begin lateral hip shift.
Step 3: Hinge torso sideways, lowering free hand down the inside of the thigh.
Step 4: Return to upright by reversing the hinge.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
common_mistakes: Looking down instead of at kettlebell
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Full hip shift before beginning the hinge
